a.xlink:title: Standalone radio link: sends barometer altitude through Telemetry::Update() every 10 ms forever.
Binds the three sensors to SPI2 and their chip selects. Does not touch hardware.
Returns the last readings and voted result.
Initializes sensor A, plus B and C if TMR_Toggle.
Configures the E22 module and leaves it in TRANS mode.
Resets the sequence and receive state. Does not touch hardware; call Init().
Reads each active sensor and recomputes the voted result.
Runs one Radio-task cycle: receive if a window is due, otherwise send.
Initializes the chip and starts continuous measurement.
Bosch delay callback: busy-waits on the DWT cycle counter.
Bosch read callback: reads len bytes starting at register reg_addr.
Bosch write callback: writes len bytes starting at register reg_addr.
Sets M0/M1 for mode, then waits up to 200 ms for AUX to go high.
Powers up the module, writes cfg to its flash, verifies it, and enters TRANS mode.
Waits for AUX to go high (module idle), polling every 1 ms.
Reads ADDH through REG3 from the module.
Writes ADDH through REG3 to the module.
Returns the last reading stored by Update().
Reads a new sample if one is ready and converts it to altitude.
Returns the mean of the two values that agree most closely.
Returns true if AUX is high (module idle).
Reads one GND frame from the module and applies it. GND → FC data path.
Sends one telemetry frame. FC → GND data path.
Finds and validates a frame in rx_buffer and copies out its payload.
Applies a GND command byte.
Blocking read of one incoming frame from the module.
Frames payload into tx_buffer and transmits it.
